name: Leshy, Seaweed
body:
SEAWEED LESHY
CR 5

This vaguely humanoid creature has a body formed of soggy green seaweed and wears crude armor made from seashells.

XP 1,600
N Small plant (leshy)
Init +5; Senses darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception +2

DEFENSE

AC 19, touch 17, flat-footed 13 (+5 Dex, +1 dodge, +2 natural, +1 size)
hp 45 (7d8+14)
Fort +7, Ref +7, Will +4
Immune electricity, plant traits, sonic

OFFENSE

Speed 20 ft., swim 20 ft.
Melee slam +5 (1d4–1)
Ranged 2 water jets +11 (2d6 plus blind)
Special Attacks verdant channel 3/day (4d6)
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 7th; concentration +8)

3/day—fog cloud
At-Will—tree shape (small seaweed only)
Constant—pass without trace, speak with plants

STATISTICS

Str 9, Dex 21, Con 14, Int 10, Wis 15, Cha 12
Base Atk +5; CMB +3; CMD 19
Feats Dodge, Far Shot, Point-Blank Shot, Precise Shot
Skills Diplomacy +8, Stealth +9 (+17 Stealth in water), Survival +9 (+17 Survival in water), Swim +7; Racial Modifiers +8 Stealth and Survival in water
Languages Common, Druidic, Sylvan

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Air Cyst (Su)

A seaweed leshy constantly grows small bulbs filled with air. As a move action, it can detach a bulb and give it to another creature. If consumed as a standard action, this air cyst grants water breathing (as the spell) for 10 minutes. A seaweed leshy can have a maximum of four usable air cysts at any one time, and air cysts regrow at a rate of one per 24 hours.

Water Jet (Ex)

A seaweed leshy can expel high-pressure jets of water from its mouth. These jets have a range increment of 20 feet. If a jet hits, the blast deals 2d6 point of bludgeoning damage unmodified by Strength. The creature hit must make a DC 15 Fortitude save or be blinded for 1 round. The save DC is Constitution-based.

Verdant Channel (Ex)

A seaweed leshy can channel verdant energy to a range of 30 feet. This acts as channel positive energy, but it can only heal plant creatures and deals no damage to undead.
